elements.description: Pick a date range from presets or two calendars, optionally compared with the period before or a year back.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The applied range; unset, the last 30 days

properties.name: presets
properties.default: [ { id: "today", label: "Today", range: (t) => ({ start: t, end: t }) }, { id: "yesterday", label: "Yesterday", range: (t) => ({ start: addDays(t, -1), end: addDays(t, -1) }) }, { id: "7d", label: "Last 7 days", range: (t) => ({ start: addDays(t, -6), end: t }) }, { id: "30d", label: "Last 30 days", range: (t) => ({ start: addDays(t, -29), end: t }) }, { id: "90d", label: "Last 90 days", range: (t) => ({ start: addDays(t, -89), end: t }) }, { id: "month", label: "This month", range: (t) => ({ start: startOfMonth(t), end: t }) }, { id: "last-month", label: "Last month", range: (t) => ({ start: addMonths(t, -1), end: endOfMonth(addMonths(t, -1)) }) }, { id: "quarter", label: "This quarter", range: (t) => ({ start: quarterStart(t), end: t }) }, { id: "ytd", label: "Year to date", range: (t) => ({ start: new Date(t.getFullYear(), 0, 1), end: t }) }, ]

properties.name: name
properties.description: Name for native form submission: a hidden input with the applied range as "YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD"

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: The trigger can't be used and the hidden input is left out of the form

properties.name: max
properties.description: Days after this can't be picked – defaults to today

properties.name: today
properties.description: "Today" for the presets – defaults to the real day, read when the element connects

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-value-change
events.description: Apply; detail `{ value, compare, mode }` – the range, the comparison range (or null) and the compare mode. Cancelable: preventDefault() keeps `value` as it is (controlled use)

events.name: tc-compare-change
events.description: Apply with another compare mode; detail `{ mode }`. Cancelable: preventDefault() keeps `compareMode` as it is

events.name: tc-open-change
events.description: The panel opens or closes; detail `{ open: boolean }`. Cancelable: preventDefault() keeps `open` as it is

props.name: value
props.description: The applied range. Controlled when defined; otherwise the picker keeps its own, starting at `defaultValue`

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting range when uncontrolled – defaults to the last 30 days

props.name: onChange
props.type: (range: DateRange, compare: DateRange | null, mode: CompareMode) => void
props.description: Called on Apply with the range and the comparison range (if any)

props.name: compareMode
props.description:
The applied comparison. Controlled when defined (changes come through onChange's third argument); otherwise
starts at `defaultCompare`

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the panel is open. Controlled when defined; otherwise starts at `defaultOpen`

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Open the panel right away – nice for previews
